fields.name: plan
fields.description: The ordered list of menu letters the demonstration traces, written at the first decision step from the demonstration steps and copied unchanged at every later step. Derive it from the highlighted targets: the first highlighted target at demo t=0 is the start; each time a new target becomes highlighted during the demo, take dy = new y minus previous highlighted y and dx = new x minus previous highlighted x (using the coordinates at the first frame each appears). |dy| >= 8 with dy > 0 means forward, dy < 0 means backward; |dx| >= 8 with dx > 0 means left, dx < 0 means right; both over threshold means the diagonal (forward=A, backward=B, left=C, right=D, forward-left=E, forward-right=F, backward-left=G, backward-right=H). One letter per newly highlighted target, in demo order. Always written as a JSON array of double-quoted uppercase letters, square brackets, comma-space separated, no single quotes and no other wrapping. e.g. ["E", "D", "G", "H"]

fields.name: moves_done
fields.description: How many of the planned moves the robot has finished executing by the scene at this step. 0 at the first decision step (nothing executed yet); at every later decision step it is the previous value plus one, since each decision step follows exactly one completed move. e.g. 2
